card.title: TKS
card.flavorText: The TKS was a Polish tankette that was produced from 1931 to 1939 and formed the bulk of the Polish armored forces at the outbreak of WWII. The TKS tankettes stood little chance against their German counterparts as they were very small and most were only armed with a single machine gun. Most were used for reconnaissance and infantry support, but a few were armed with a 20 mm gun which made them more effective against enemy tanks.
